segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I pulled up the order form from last week. We have 42 seats at $68 per seat per month, annual term starting February 1st, and the one-time onboarding fee at $2,400. Does that match what you were expecting?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep, that lines up. The only thing I wanted to confirm is billing. Our finance team asked if the annual invoice can be issued on January 20th, but due net 30 from the February 1st start date.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, so invoice dated January 20th with payment due March 3rd, since February is short. I can note that for billing. The system may show net 30 from invoice date, but we can have the billing tool override the due date on the actual invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that helps. And for seats, we may start with 38 active users and add the other 4 after training. Is there any issue with that?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: No issue. You’ll have 42 contracted seats available on day one, and your admin can assign them as needed. If you go above 42, it’ll prompt for approval and we can true up on a prorated basis.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Got it. On contract language, our legal team asked about auto-renewal. They’re okay with it, but they want 60 days’ notice instead of 30.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That’s pretty standard. I’ll send that to deal desk today. It usually comes back same day, and then I can generate the revised order form with the 60-day non-renewal notice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. Our target go-live is February 12th. Is that still workable if we sign by Friday?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. If we have signature by January 17th, we can schedule kickoff the week of January 27th, get the data import done by February 5th, and leave a few days for admin review before the 12th.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Send the updated order form when you have it, and I’ll route it for signature.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. I’ll update the CRM after this call, get the 60-day renewal change approved, and send the order form over this afternoon if there are no questions from deal desk.
